title: Pezeshkian: Iran’s Presence in SCO and BRICS Aimed at Countering Unilateralism
text:
"Pezeshkian: Iran’s Presence in SCO and BRICS Aimed at Countering Unilateralism"

""
"Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian told Russian President Vladimir Putin during their meeting:  "

"“Our presence in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization and BRICS is to fight against unilateralism.”  "

"“We naturally align with and defend your view that multilateralism must take shape,” he added.  "

"“We hope that this ongoing effort will bring victory to us, to you, and to all nations seeking to break free from unilateralism. I am certain we will prevail—this is our belief, and we stand firm with God’s help.”
